description.translate: Garrick believes me now? Then perhaps I was wrong to give up. Bring sixteen oak planks. These broken walls will not keep another storm away from my records. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

A dry room is a modest beginning. I recorded the test that damaged Garrick's forge. Tears for Fears already held the Warden's call. The apparatus was driven past its measured limit, and the vibration reached the fittings before the furnace could have caused that damage.
